title: [BUG] Frequent IDE disconnections disrupting workflow in VS Code integration
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [x] Other: Max Plan
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.64
- Operating System: macOS Darwin arm64 24.5.0
- Terminal: VS Code integrated terminal

## Bug Description
The IDE connection to VS Code frequently disconnects during normal usage. Even after manually reconnecting using `/ide`
command and selecting VS Code, the connection drops again within a few minutes, showing "IDE disconnected" message.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start Claude CLI in VS Code integrated terminal
2. Run `/ide` command and select VS Code to establish connection
3. Work normally for a few minutes (editing files, running commands)
4. Observe "IDE disconnected" message appears
5. Repeat steps 2-4, connection drops again within minutes

## Expected Behavior
The IDE connection should remain stable throughout the entire Claude CLI session without frequent disconnections.

## Actual Behavior
The IDE connection drops every few minutes, requiring manual reconnection. This disrupts workflow and reduces
productivity as the connection needs to be re-established repeatedly.

## Additional Context
- Claude CLI installed globally via npm: `npm install -g @anthropic/claude-cli`
- VS Code version: 1.102.3 (Commit: 488a1f239235055e34e673291fb8d8c810886f81)
- Using VS Code on Apple Silicon Mac
- Node.js version: 22.17.1
- The issue occurs consistently across different projects and workspaces
- No specific action seems to trigger the disconnection - it happens during normal file editing and command execution
